description: This bar chart illustrates the average performance of five different methods, with the horizontal axis displaying the method names—“Self-RAG,” “FactTune,” “ClinGS (w/)”, and “ClinGS”—and the vertical axis labeled “Average Performance” ranging from 0 to 60 on a linear scale. The bars are arranged in ascending order of performance from left to right, with the shortest bar corresponding to “Self-RAG” at approximately 56, followed by “FactTune” at approximately 59, “ClinGS (w/)” at approximately 62, and the tallest bar for “ClinGS” reaching approximately 64. Each bar is colored distinctly: “Self-RAG” is orange, “FactTune” is olive green, “ClinGS (w/)” is blue-gray, and “ClinGS” is royal blue. The bars are not grouped or stacked but are presented individually side-by-side. There is no visual emphasis such as shading, bolding, or outlines on any of the bars, and no annotations are present.
